summary_markdown:
A discussion began regarding a specific sensor location (Mediateko_FL_Helsinki CS 2) associated with the company Mediateko, which was noted to have no traffic. Someone provided a map link and suggested the sensor should be located in the visible area if it hasn't been removed or moved.

It was confirmed that the location is currently pending review (in RMC). The general consensus was that the client/site would eventually become accessible, leading to a decision to write an inquiry letter to confirm the status of the traffic.
decisions: The sensor location with no recorded traffic will be treated as acceptable for now.
action_items: Write a letter/email to inquire about the sensor's traffic status and accessibility.
